scripts.contracts:types: npm run contracts:openapi && npx openapi-typescript openapi.json -o static/api-types.d.ts
scripts.contracts:check-generated: py scripts/check_openapi.py && npx openapi-typescript openapi.json --check -o static/api-types.d.ts
